'''Lasgo Port''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on an [[Unidentified planet (Lasgo Port)|unidentified planet]] that was visited by [[Ania Solo]] and her companions in [[139 ABY]]. The planet was known to have an arena where [[yarthul]]s were tamed. While visiting Lasgo Port, Ania and her companions discovered that the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] had placed a bounty on her head for the alleged murder of the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Teemen Alton]]. Shortly later, Ania was kidnapped by her former lover [[Ramid]], who wanted to claim the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head.
